text:
Olivia Ramos: Quick sync — we need to lock SKUs, licensing terms, and billing cadence for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Launch target 2024-06-18. Thoughts? :spiral_calendar:
Ravi Shah: Legal here — need EULA variants per cloud region, data residency callouts, and the indemnity language for third-party infra. I can do redlines by EOD if we confirm SKU granularity.
Carla Mendes: Product POV — proposing 2 SKUs: `redwood-standard` (shared, pay-as-you-go) and `redwood-dedicated` (reserved monthly). We should also include an add-on SKU for premium support. I'll update the feature matrix.
Nico Park: Sales ask — customers want hourly while they experiment. Can we surface both monthly and hourly pricing in the cloud catalogs, with a note that hourly is beta on Dedicated?
Olivia Ramos: Prefer monthly as default for marketplace listings. Hourly can be listed as "developer preview" for Dedicated on AWS & GCP; Azure needs legal sign-off.
Ravi Shah: Azure requires explicit billing cadence in the offer docs. Also need localized terms (FR/DE) for EU regions. @Mike Chen can you confirm localization timeline?
Mike Chen: Yep — localization batch 1 (EN, FR, DE) ready next week. We'll feed translations into the listing assets. Also pinging infra: are AMI/container images final?
marketplace-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-marketplace/listings/marketplace_assets_v2.tar.gz (sha256: abc123...)
Carla Mendes: SKU mapping draft (copied here):
```
SKU,Product,Plan,Region
RDW-STD,Redwood Standard,monthly,global
RDW-DED,Redwood Dedicated,monthly+commit,US/EU/APAC
RDW-SUP,Redwood Support,addon,global
```
Carla Mendes: We'll need per-cloud metadata: AMI IDs for AWS, image URIs for GCP, and offer package ID for Azure. I'll create a checklist in the doc.
Ravi Shah: Also adding checklist items: privacy attestations, export controls, and SOC evidence pointer. Legal needs the contact person for SOC docs — @Olivia Ramos?
Olivia Ramos: Assigned — I'll be the SOC contact. Ravi, I'll DM the SOC packet.
Nico Park: For pricing page copy, can marketing draft two short blurbs? One focused on performance/cost for Standard and one on isolation/SLA for Dedicated.
Mike Chen: We should also finalize entitlements mapping: which features are gated by license (e.g., KV cache persistence, private VPC). I have a spreadsheet where I can add toggles per SKU.
Carla Mendes: Good call. I'll sync the feature toggles to the SKU sheet and mark required integration points.
Olivia Ramos: Action items summary: 1) Legal redlines by Ravi (EOD), 2) Product to publish SKU sheet (Carla, EOD), 3) Localization confirm (Mike, next-week), 4) Marketing blurbs (Nico, 48h), 5) Ops to confirm images and AMIs (Mike). If no blockers, reconvene tomorrow 10:00am PT to lock final assets.
Ravi Shah: Sounds good. I'll flag any Azure-specific clauses if they appear during packaging.
Nico Park: Putting a couple of customer asks into the doc now (hourly use cases).
marketplace-bot: reminder set: listing-assets-deadline in 24h
Olivia Ramos: Thanks all — we should be able to hit the catalog submission window if everyone sticks to the checklist. :rocket:
